_comment: Haymitch's District 12. Device: the insert. A tactile detail fills the screen before the photo it belongs to: fingers working a small handmade trinket and the geese come before the couple; a stained shirt and worn jacket cuff come before Haymitch's face at the reaping. Between them: light through a doorway, the fence wire, a hand on a cheek. Everything builds to one uninterrupted hold on young Haymitch's portrait on bar 5; the meadow with the geese then leads back to the hands.
